author: codex
description: Batch outgoing events by destination with a configurable maximum of 100 events per request. Delivery reports include accepted and failed event counts; independent destinations can still progress after transport errors.

defects.mechanism: The batch path acknowledges every submitted event, ignoring the Transport contract that only returned IDs were accepted. Partial acceptance silently drops the remaining events from the outbox.
Each batch is submitted twice before its acceptance is processed, doubling metered transport requests and producing duplicate webhook deliveries.
